findings.title: Latest daily sample permits outcome selection
findings.section: Planning Contract — Metrics, Action Pins and Re-measurement
findings.why_it_matters: Repeated manual checks can change the measured trend even though each day still contributes one sample: a scheduled answer without a recommendation can be replaced by a later favorable answer, and rerunning until favorable can turn the after-window rate into apparent improvement. KTD8 (one observation per day) prevents extra weighting but does not prevent this outcome selection; the U6 (comparable re-measurement) test promises stronger protection than the sampling rule provides. Freezing the first successful daily sample preserves equal weighting and prevents later manual outcomes from replacing the measurement sample.
evidence: KTD8. Metrik memakai sampel dan coverage yang terlihat. Cohort prompt-version/engine/configuration tetap; satu successful observation terakhir per pasangan per hari UTC mencegah manual checks membobot ulang tren.
Manual observations remain inspectable but at most the latest successful sample per UTC day enters trends.
repeated manual sampling cannot distort daily trends
findings.suggested_fix: Change KTD8 (daily cohort sampling), the measurement rule, and U6 (comparable re-measurement) to use the first successful eligible capture per fixed cohort and UTC day, with later manual captures still inspectable as latest evidence. Add the concrete U6 scenario where a later favorable manual capture cannot replace that day's already-selected measurement sample; preserve the existing coverage and limited-data labels.

dispositions.finding: Latest daily sample permits outcome selection
dispositions.reason: R20 promises comparable descriptive measurement and U6 promises repeated manual sampling cannot distort trends. Latest-success selection permits replacement with a favorable stochastic result. First-success fixed sampling closes this at no extra infrastructure cost and preserves manual fresh captures.
dispositions.correction: Replace latest daily measurement selection with first successful eligible frozen sample; add later-favorable-manual scenario.
